title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to quickly remove Non-Alphanumeric Characters in AL
summary: This post explains how to remove non-alphanumeric characters from strings in Dynamics 365 Business Central using the built-in StringConversionManagement codeunit. It provides a practical example of applying character filtering during data validation on the Customer Card form.
key_points: Use codeunit 47 StringConversionManagement and its RemoveNonAlphaNumericCharacters method to filter strings
The method leaves only letters A-Z and numbers 0-9, removing special characters, symbols, spaces, and emoji
Can be applied in page extensions using OnBeforeValidate triggers to clean data during user input
Offers a cleaner built-in solution compared to custom methods for handling non-alphanumeric character removal
